rules.name: Evidence First
rules.body: Keep every result tied to actual local processing and show scope caveats.

dos: Do distinguish rendered RGB from Bayer sensor inputs.
Do explain local execution and experimental limitations.
donts: Don't invent proof or performance claims.
Don't use colored glow or animate full-resolution imagery.
